lines.en: I tap on Chinami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Chinami hotline! Thank you for calling during happy hour!
: It’s happy hour?
: Every hour is happy hour! Life is good! Buy giraffes!
: But I still haven’t received the first ones I ordered.
: Sorry. You need to call our customer support line if you want help with that. This is the giraffe center.
I sigh to myself and wonder for what feels like the millionth time why I’m calling one of my student’s little sisters.
I then hang up and dial the customer support number to follow up on the giraffe situation.
Just kidding.
: Where are you right now, Chinami? It sounds kind of loud.
: Would you like a hint?
: Sure. Why not?
: Arf!
: Oh, you’re at the mall.
: Is Chika there?
: Of course big sis Chika is there. Did you think Chinami came here all by herself?
: That’s...a good point. I’m not really sure why I asked that.
: Well Chinami is glad you did! And she’s also glad you agreed to babysit her!
: Bye bye, Papa! See you soon!
I slowly shove my phone back into my pocket and begin to head over to the bus station to hang out with a girl in a dog mask.
: Arf!
: I can’t imagine it’s very easy to drink that with a dog mask on.
: Doggies can’t drink strawberry milk. They’ll get a tummy ache.
: Can you remind me why I spent money on buying you a drink you can not consume?
: Because you love Chinami.
: I do not love Chinami.
: But you bought her strawberry milk and a cell phone.
: Is that really how kids are judging love nowadays?
: Chinami doesn’t know. She’s not old enough to fall in love.
I quickly scan the mall to see how any onlookers might be viewing this...scene.
I immediately find that it’s not very good.
: Chinami, is there any way we could get you a less...conspicuous costume for when you come to the mall?
: Oh right. Chinami forgot you hate puppies.
: This is just kind of weird any way you look at it.
: Okay! Chinami understands that it would be normal for you to be seen with a little girl without a helmet on.
: She’ll call her people and see what they can do.
: But in the meantime-
: Arf!
Again, I find myself leaning back in my chair and wondering how my life has gotten to this point.
I don’t have to wonder for very long, though, as I quickly remember that it was my idea to call her.
Could I have just left her at the clothing store with her sister? Absolutely.
Would it have been more socially acceptable for me to do that?
Again, absolutely.
Should I stop calling her altogether and begin hanging out with people that I couldn’t go to jail for just looking at?
For a third time, absolutely.
But, no matter how many times I say “absolutely,” I have a hard time believing I’ll ever really figure out how to stay away from this...demon slash CEO slash wizard slash dog.
: Your eyebrows are being all...eyebrowy again.
: I am a grown man sitting at a table with a little girl in a dog mask who is holding a box of strawberry milk for sheer aesthetic purposes.
: Arf!
: I’m glad that you understand.
: What...the...fuck...
: Oh, good. Now I’m a grown man sitting at a table with a little girl in a dog mask with aesthetic strawberry milk who has to explain to his students exactly what is happening.
: I mean...yeah?
: Um...Hi, puppy?
: Arf!
: Please tell me you’re not going to pretend she’s a real puppy.
: Otoha, I need you to think about this.
: If we just accept and agree that it is a puppy, we can all move on and forget that this ever happened.
: I like Rin’s idea.
: Arf!
: Did you kidnap her?
: What? No. What would give you that idea?
: The fact that you once made plans with Nodoka and Rin to kidnap me.
: Hey. Noriko was there too.
: We all supported yuritopia and she needs to absorb some of the blame for me.
: Yuri...topia?
: Hahaha! Hahah...Noooo idea what Sensei’s talking about.
: What’s a “yuritopia?”
: A magical world where all dreams come true.
: Not all dreams. Just yours.
: Will Chinami’s dreams come true in yuritopia as well?
: You still have several years left to figure that out, Chinami.
: Chinami certainly hopes so!
: Chinami?...
: That name sounds kind of familiar.
: Care to join us, Otoha?
: And be an accessory to whatever like, fifty felonies you’re committing right now? I'm good.
: I’m not doing anything wrong. I’m just babysitting.
: Arf!
: Are teaching wages so bad that you need to pick up a second job just to keep yourself afloat?
: They’re not great. That’s definitely true. But I’m doing this job for free.
: Yeah, I'm still good.
: Where in the world do I know that name from?
: Rin, pull up a seat with your girlfriend and hang out with us. Having two [teenage]girls with me as well as Chinami might somehow make me look...less bad.
: G-Girlfriend?!
: Come on, man. Why would you say that?
: Because it will work. Watch.
: Um...it doesn’t have to be for long...but...it probably would help Sensei out a little...
: You finally summoned up the courage to come here and this is how you want to spend your time?
: Like I said...it won’t be for long...
: How did you know that was going to work?
: Honestly, it would have worked even if I left the girlfriend part out. I just like when Rin gets flustered.
: You’re a real asshole sometimes, you know that?
: No one knows that better than me, Otoha.
Rin and Otoha grab chairs from a nearby table and join us at ours.
Of course, their attention isn’t even slightly focused on me.
Instead, it is focused on man’s best friend- a small girl in a dog costume.
: So...um...Chinami, right?
: Arf!
: ...What?
: I think that means yes. I used to have a dog.
: Do you...come here often?
: Rin, please don’t flirt with the puppy.
: That’s not what I’m doing! I’ve just...never talked to a dog before! I don’t really know what to ask.
: Chinami comes every once in a while!
: But she can’t come very much because she gets sick easily.
: Arf?
: Arf! Arf arf!
: Arf arf...arf arf?
: Arf! Arf arf!
: Ohmygodohmygodohmygod.
: Otoha, would you mind explaining what you’re doing?
: I don’t know. Playing along I guess?
: Must be boring as hell having someone like you as a babysitter, so I’m just stepping in and trying to make things less lame.
: You’re making things less lame by barking at a girl in a dog costume?
: Hey! Don’t blame me for being good with kids.
: Umm...I’m too embarrassed to bark at you like my not-girlfriend, Otoha, but...I’m happy to meet you Chinami.
: Chinami is happy to meet you as well!
: Are you also friends with her big sisters?
: Big sisters? Do they go to our[school]?
: Chinami, you probably shouldn’t be talking about that to-
: There’s big sis Chika and big sis Yumi! But only big sis Chika is related to Chinami by blood.
: That’s where I’ve heard your name before.
: Did Chinami say something wrong?
: No. You didn’t say anything wrong.
: It’s...uhh...
: It's nice to meet you, Chinami. I’m Rin.
: I’m...going to take a wild guess and assume your sister’s never mentioned me before?
: Hmm...
: Chinami’s memory is very bad, so she isn’t sure.
: Rin, you know we can change the topic if this is weird for you, right?
: Yeah...
: That's...probably what we should do.
: I guess it doesn’t really matter if she mentioned me or not. We’re friends, though.
: Or...I think we’re friends? It’s a confusing...thing.
: But I’m really happy to finally meet you.
: Chinami is confused.
: Why is Chinami confused?
: Because you’re saying you’re happy but your eyes are all teary.
: Oh.
: Huh.
: I guess they are.
: And here I thought I was done crying over this.
: So you’re not happy? Chinami wants to confirm.
: She isn't used to the complex emotions of [teenager]s.
: Are you happy, Chinami? Cause it would make me happy if you’re happy.
: Chinami is super duper happy! She has two amazing sisters and an amazing new Papa who gets to babysit her at the mall.
: Oh, good. As if this couldn’t get any weirder.
: Strangely enough, I don’t really think this is as weird as the first time people saw me with her in full costume.
: Weirder than finally getting Rin to accept the end of her crush on that girl...only to show up and bump into her little sister in a dog mask? Because that's pretty friggin' doubtful, man.
: Crush?
: Chinami is sorry for asking, but aren’t you a girl?
: Yes, Chinami. I’m a girl.
: And you know Chinami’s sisters are girls too, right?
: And you still liked her anyway?
: Are you allowed to do that?
: Well...
: I wasn't.
: But I guess it never really mattered since she didn’t like me the same way.
: Chinami is very confused. She-
: Wait!
: Chinami remembers something!
: But it’s very fuzzy. Like a puppy.
: What...is it?
: Big sis Chika did mention someone called Rin once!
: She did?...
: Do you...remember what she said, by any chance?
: Umm...
: Chinami thinks...
: Chinami thinks she said you had very pretty eyes. And that she wanted hers to look more like yours.
: That’s it?
: Chinami thinks so. She can’t remember any other Rins and big sis Yumi never talks about anybody.
: Heheh...hahahah!
: Better than nothing, I guess!
: Still not as weird as the first time?
: I’m not sure. This has lasted a lot longer than that did.
: But I feel that this is probably weirder for you than any of us since you're entirely unrelated to...pretty much all of it.
: Chinami is so surprised! Until today, she didn’t know that girls could like other girls!
: Yeah, I’m not gonna lie. I'm mad uncomfortable right now, so I think I’m gonna like...go walk around or something and...let you guys finish up on your own.
: I...can stop?
: It just kinda happened out of nowhere and...I don’t want you to feel weird about me getting all emotional over it.
: Don’t sweat it. When you’ve gotta cry, you’ve gotta cry.
: But...again...this whole romance thing is just-
: Well, to use Sensei’s words-
: Entirely unrelated to me.
: Sooooooooyeah. I’m gonna go grab a milkshake or something and-
: I’ll come with you. Don’t leave.
: Rin, you really don’t-
: Nope! I’m done here.
: Not gonna waste a perfectly good opportunity to hang out with you getting upset over stuff that’s in the past.
: Thanks for talking to me, Chinami.
: And please don’t say anything about this to either one of your sisters. I don’t really want to confront it again after it’s already over.
: Chinami will do what you say!
: But she wants you to know that big sis Chika would never hurt you on purpose. She’s a very nice girl!
: Yeah...
: I know she is...
: Just gonna go right back to jabbing your fake tongue against that straw, huh?
: Chinami feels like she wound up in a sticky situation just now! She’s parched!
: All things considered, I think you handled it really well.
: Chinami had no idea what to do when the girl with more red in her hair started barking at her! What is she, crazy?!
: I can’t believe I’m about to say this...but don’t ever change, Chinami.
: You want Chinami to stay little forever?
: Okay. Maybe change a little bit. I wouldn’t want you stunting your growth for me.
: Arf!
My phone suddenly goes off and I look down to see that Chika’s about to clock out for break and that my shift as “babysitter” is over.
I think I’ll wind up sticking around for a little while longer, though.
I’m in no rush to leave and-
Honestly, having both Chosokabes around at once might be the exact medicine I need to counteract the overabundance of sadness and longing I just had to sit through.
: Chinami wants another strawberry milk! Go, Papa! Go!
I text Chika, asking her to bring her sister a drink on the way over.
Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!
